sentences.ar: بعد الضهر، الكل نام من التعب.
sentences.en: In the afternoon, everyone slept from exhaustion.

sentences.ar: أنا ما قدرت أنام وفكرت بفكرة.
sentences.en: I could not sleep and thought of an idea.
I took two pistols and food and went out secretly.

sentences.ar: ما حكيت لحدا، وهاي كانت غلطة.
sentences.en: I told no one, and that was a mistake.

sentences.ar: لقيت مركب بن غن تحت الشجر.
sentences.en: I found Ben Gunn’s boat under the trees.
It was very small and light.
